content: Image Watermark Removal Baselines.We evaluateRAVEN against 14 watermark removal attacks across threecategories. (i) Classical Signal Processing: brightness ad-justment, contrast modification, JPEG compression, Gaus-sian blur, additive Gaussian noise, and BM3D denois-ing [11]. These pixel-space operations serve as widely used,low-cost baselines. (ii) Regeneration Attacks: Regen [47]regenerates watermarked images via diffusion-based nois-ing and denoising. Rinse iteratively applies Regen multipletimes for improved removal. We also test two VAE-basedcompression models at quality level 3: VAE-B [3] and VAE-C [7].
